newsitem.title: LATVIA: SAVINGS BANK BACK IN PROFIT IN 1996.
newsitem.headline: SAVINGS BANK BACK IN PROFIT IN 1996.

text.p: The Latvian Savings Bank (Krajbanka) said on Friday that its 1996 pre-tax profit was 1.06 million lats against a 1995 loss of 5.05 million lats.

"Our audited results show a profit of 1.066 million lats and the report of Coopers and Lybrand is without remarks for the first time in Savings Banks' history," Ivar Godmanis, bank council chairman told a news conference.
"From a stage of saving the bank we have now entered a development stage," Godmanis said.

"The first stage of privatisation is completed, which gave an increase of one million lats in capital and a modern affiliate (Union Baltic Bank) with experience on the commercial bank market," he added.
